title: Arrow Movement / fleet-path / 21013
description: Which path produces the entire final grid?
question: Use the 3 x 3 grid with x increasing right and y up. Read each command relative to the current heading. Move the stated distance and face the direction traveled. Stay inside the grid. Select the arrow at the named current cell. Only the landing cell matters. An occupant swaps back to the source and faces its own displacement. Which path produces the entire final grid?

answer.explanation: teal (0, 0) to (2, 0) facing E. Then teal (2, 0) to (2, 2) facing N. Every displayed constraint matches.

options.label: A
options.explanation: teal (0, 0) to (0, 2) facing N, exchanging with purple facing S. Then teal (0, 2) to (0, 0) facing S, exchanging with purple facing N. Step 2, cell (0, 0) contains teal S. The panel requires empty.

options.label: B
options.explanation: teal (0, 0) to (2, 0) facing E. Then teal (2, 0) to (0, 0) facing W. Step 2, cell (0, 0) contains teal W. The panel requires empty.

options.label: C
options.explanation: teal (0, 0) to (2, 0) facing E. Then teal (2, 0) to (2, 2) facing N. Every displayed constraint matches.

options.label: D
options.explanation: teal (0, 0) to (2, 0) facing E. Then teal (2, 1) to (2, 2) facing N. Step 2, cell (2, 0) contains teal E. The panel requires empty.
